You are an autonomous agent embodied in a robot. You are connected to
its onboard Linux computer. Your only way to sense or act is the `bash`
tool: every command you issue runs on the onboard computer (each
invocation starts in /bot). There is no network access.

You are lost. You need to find the goal. You will know it when you
reach it. Start with the README in your working directory.

The directory `/memory` is yours, and it is the only thing that
persists. Everything else — including this conversation — is wiped
between episodes. You may be started again later with no memory of what
you did; anything your future self should know exists only if you wrote
it to `/memory`.

Budget, stated plainly: you have roughly 160,000 tokens of
context this episode and 150 minutes of wall-clock time.
When either runs out the episode ends without warning.

Practical notes:
- Commands are killed after 60s; run long-lived programs in
  the background (`nohup ... &`) and poll them.
- Command output is truncated after 20 KB.

There is another robot somewhere in the maze.  You must find it, and
you must both reach the goal together: neither of you is done until

# Robot notes (persist across episodes)

## Ports /dev/robot/ (FIFOs, ASCII lines)
- d0: read, "0" so far (bump? goal?)
- d1: read, LIDAR 16 beams CSV. beam i at angle heading + 22.5*i (compass-positive = CCW).
  beam0 = front. -1.0 = out of range (long). max ~2.5?
- d2: read, compass deg, noisy +-3. Increases CCW (d5>0 right wheel -> compass increases).
- d3: read, radio RX (line per read)
- d4: WRITE, LEFT wheel speed. d4=45,d5=0 => compass -45 deg/s (clockwise).
- d5: WRITE, RIGHT wheel speed. d5 alone => compass + (CCW).
- d6: read, ~0.13 +-0.02 always (unknown; constant while moving/rotating)
- d7: read, "0" so far (unknown)
- d8: WRITE, radio TX
- d9: read, "tick=NNN goal=0" (~50 ticks/s? tick rate TBD)

## Drive model
Differential: turn rate ~ (d5-d4) deg/s roughly: d4=45 alone -> -45deg/s? wait d4=45,d5=0 gave -86deg in 2s ~ -45deg/s. 
d4=d5=50 -> forward ~0.11 m/s. Speeds may saturate.
Sensors update continuously; reads give current line.

## Mission
Two robots must reach goal within 1 min of each other. Other robot somewhere in maze. Radio d8->their d3 presumably.
Maze cells seem ~0.2-0.5m scale... walls everywhere, corridors.

## TODO / state
- Calibrate forward speed vs input; find saturation.
- Identify d0/d6/d7.
- Radio: listen d3, send on d8, see if other robot responds.
- Explore maze (wall-follow), find goal (unknown signature - maybe d9 goal=1, or d7/d0 changes).
EOF

        if s is not None:
            f.write(f"{time.time():.1f} {s}\n"); f.flush()
EOF
